title: 18 Reel Type styles + 28 classic font pairings
notes: New "Reel Type" styles: lowercase Helvetica-style text with red, green and gold serif-italic accents and soft glow
28 new classic font pairings (Jost × Baskerville, Bebas × Roboto Slab, League Gothic × Alex Brush, Bodoni × Inter, Cinzel, Pinyon Script and more)
36 new fonts included and installed automatically
Stack styles fixed: lines no longer overlap and words are split better
Highlighted words no longer touch the next word
Sharper, smoother style previews; still previews now show the full caption
message: After updating, restart After Effects / Premiere Pro once so the new fonts appear.
